title: KSP1 stock and expansion parts inventory expansion
scope: KSP 1.12.x stock part families, with DLC labels where source identifies them
source: Japanese KSP Wiki parts index; this is an inventory transcription, not an asset license
caveat: The source page contains a base-game inventory and links to separate Making History and Breaking Ground sections. This file captures the additional stock families visible in its parts index; it is not yet the complete DLC list. Internal IDs and exact part.cfg data remain unverified until checked against KSP 1.12.5.
licensing: The source wiki's thumbnails and game images are not copied. Extracted KSP stock/DLC models and textures are not redistributed. The browser models must be independently authored or sourced from explicitly redistributable assets.
